posts.title: Day 7: Hey, There’s Actually Some Hills Here
posts.description: Another’s day, another few dozen fields. Such is the way of the Pieterpad. When I left my B&B this morning, I had no idea where I was actually going to finish tonight. The place I contacted last night hadn’t replied back, which left me with two alternatives: another B&B in 20 km, and a campground in 22 km that’s a kilometer off the trail. Not the greatest options, but I’ve had to deal with worse.

posts.title: Day 6: Fields and Forests and Canals
posts.description: On an often nice, though occasionally rainy day, the Pieterpad continued winding its way around fields and canals (and through the occasional forest), as it continued to make its way south. It was bright and sunny this morning, a much nicer start to the day than I’d expected, though rain was forecast for this afternoon. posts.title: Day 5: A More Varied Landscape
posts.description: A beautiful day saw a lot more forest than prior days on the Pieterpad. The breakfast I ordered yesterday was delivered right on time, and was simple, but tasty. (A piece of bread, two heated rolls, cheese, ham, butter, jelly, and a hard-boiled egg.)
